entries.zh: 输；运送、输送（货物）；（买卖中）输掉、亏本
entries.en: to convey/transport (goods); to lose (in a transaction)
entries.notes: 西语 en carru 疑为 en carro（用车运载）或 en caro（贵价出卖），汉字“输”兼“运送/输掉”二义，取运送为主。

entries.zh: 传；传递、传话（代传他人之物/讯息）
entries.en: to pass on, to transmit; to convey (goods or a message) from another
entries.notes: 西语 de otro astro 疑有讹字，取“传”之传递/转递义。

entries.zh: 寄；寄送、寄存；寄卖（代人寄售货物）
entries.en: to send; to consign; to deposit (goods for sale on another's behalf)
entries.notes: 西语 afa de otro astro 疑为 a fía（赊账）等讹读，取“寄”之寄送/寄卖义。

entries.zh: 抱；怀抱、抱持（于手中/怀中）
entries.en: to hold in the arms, to embrace (e.g. carry a small animal in one's arms)
entries.notes: 西语 dela man de un animo 疑有讹字，取“抱”怀抱本义。

entries.zh: 抱；抱在怀里（抱持而行）
entries.en: to carry in the arms; to embrace

entries.zh: 扛；两人抬扛（重物）
entries.en: to carry (a load) between two people; to shoulder together

entries.zh: 抬（原写“摕”，疑为“擡”）；协力抬举
entries.en: to lift, to carry together (likely 擡; the recorded 摕 is doubtful)
entries.notes: 汉字标注[疑:擡]，擡＝抬举，与两人共抬之担语境相合。

entries.zh: 担（擔）；以扁担挑担（一竿挑两担）
entries.en: to carry (loads) on a shoulder-pole; to shoulder a carrying-pole

entries.zh: 掎；牵引、拖曳（拽物而行）
entries.en: to drag, to pull along (a load)
entries.notes: “掎”字罕见，西语 vno vna carga ~ vno nombre 有讹字，牵曳之义存疑。

entries.zh: 载；装载、载运（驮载于牲口）
entries.en: to load; to carry a load (e.g. on a beast of burden)

entries.zh: 牵；牵手、牵引（以手牵行）
entries.en: to lead by the hand; to pull along

entries.zh: 背（原写“佩”）；背负、背载
entries.en: to carry on the back / on one's shoulders (recorded char 佩 doubtful; sound puè = 背)
entries.notes: 对音 puè 合于闽南语“背”（背负），原汉字“佩”疑误；M 栏末音节标 T99 污损难辨。

entries.zh: 负；背负（以背载物）
entries.en: to carry on the back; to bear a load

entries.zh: 驭；驭马、骑乘
entries.en: to drive (a horse); to ride on horseback
entries.notes: 词头作 Uenar 而“驭/骑”义与 sobre el caballo（马上）语境相合，或为 Venir 之讹，释义取汉字本义。

entries.zh: 携；携带、拿取（负物而行）
entries.en: to take, to carry off (something)
entries.notes: 汉字第三字“摧”可疑；官话对音 hū 疑为“负”，皆指向携带/负载义。

entries.zh: 放肩头（原写“肓”，疑为“肩”）；把担子放上肩头
entries.en: to place the load on the shoulder (肓 likely 肩)
entries.notes: 汉字标注[疑:肓/肩]，与西语 al hombro（在肩上）互证。

entries.zh: 放背脊；把担子放上背脊
entries.en: to place the load on the back

entries.zh: 帕去（原写“怕”，疑为“帕”）；用帕/布包裹而去
entries.en: to go wrapped up in a cloth (帕; recorded 怕 doubtful)
entries.notes: 汉字标注[疑:怕/帕]，与 embuelto en paño（以布包裹）相合。

entries.zh: 极到价；价钱涨到极点（卖得高价）
entries.en: to fetch a top price; the price has risen to the utmost

entries.zh: 解粮；解送粮草（军队之粮饷/贡赋）
entries.en: to deliver/convey provisions or tribute in grain for the army

entries.zh: 解纪人〔字义存疑〕；解送（贡赋/文书）予上级之人
entries.en: one who delivers (tribute or documents) to a superior (characters uncertain)
entries.notes: “纪”字可疑、西语 el treo 有讹字，确义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 解批；呈解批文（判词/公文）予上级核阅批准
entries.en: to send up a written sentence / official document (批) for the superior to review and approve
